blocks.title: Welcome to Polynomials
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: For the quadratic x² − 5x + 6, find the product of its zeroes.
blocks.body_hi: For the quadratic x² − 5x + 6, find the product of its zeroes.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: If the sum and product of zeroes of a quadratic are 4 and 3 respectively, find the quadratic's coefficient ratio -b/a (i.e., find -b/a which equals the sum).
blocks.body_hi: If the sum and product of zeroes of a quadratic are 4 and 3 respectively, find the quadratic's coefficient ratio -b/a (i.e., find -b/a which equals the sum).
